Meta.title: Tesla Explorer
Meta.description: Evening drive planner for Tesla owners in the USA: routes that fit charge and time, 3D map, clips about stops.

Home.finalBody: Create an account and start planning your ideal evenings with Tesla Explorer.
Home.demoCaption: Example workspace: describe your evening, then open your planned route on the map.
Home.carExample: Example profile. You enter the battery level before each trip.
Home.headline: Your evenings can be more
Home.pitch: Tesla Explorer is an AI planner for evening drives. It factors in battery charge, free time, and what you care about.
Home.proofPreview: Preview the trip before you leave
Home.howBody: From an idea to a ready-to-go trip in one place. Describe your evening: Tesla Explorer finds places and plans a route. Then preview your trip on the map.
Home.featuresTitle: More time for what actually matters
Home.feature1Title: Don’t hunt routes. Describe the evening.
Home.feature1Body: Say what you want — dinner, kids, water. The planner builds the loop.
Home.feature2Body: Current %, model, and real conditions. A charger lands in the chain when needed.
Home.feature3Title: Watch the trip before you leave
Home.feature3Body: A 3D route preview and information about each stop — know what your evening has in store.
Home.carTitle: Your car is part of the experience
Home.carBody: Model and range shape every plan. Set the profile once.
Home.finalScript: The best routes start after work
Home.demoChatUser: Chinese food and a walk with the kids near water
Home.demoChatAssistant: Dinner nearby, then a short lakeside walk. Opening the map…
Home.demoChatPlaceholder: e.g. dinner and a calm loop
Home.heroPromptExample: Chinese food and a walk with the kids near water

Onboarding.addressesHint: Save your starting points to keep them handy when planning a route.
Onboarding.vehicleHint: Your model helps account for driving range when planning. Vehicle image is illustrative.
Onboarding.batteryHint: You can set the current battery level before each trip — no need to save it here.
Onboarding.saveHint: Your preferences help the guide find places you’ll enjoy.
Onboarding.title: Create your profile
Onboarding.intro: Save your home and work addresses, who rides with you, kids, and which Tesla you drive. Battery is asked when you plan a trip.
Onboarding.introEdit: Update home, work, household, or Tesla model — your guide uses these on every plan.
Onboarding.addressSearchUnavailable: Address search is currently unavailable. Enter the full address manually.
Onboarding.aboutMePlaceholder: Age vibe, energy, what makes a great evening drive
Onboarding.interestsPlaceholder: Food you like, places you enjoy, things to avoid
Onboarding.errorGeneric: Check the form and try again.
Onboarding.errorSave: Could not save your profile. Try again.
Onboarding.errorUnauthorized: Sign in again to save your profile.

Auth.welcomeBody: Beautiful places, favorite routes, and time for yourself. It all starts with an idea.
Auth.welcomeNote: Your routes. Your Tesla. Your pace.
Auth.welcomeIntro: Sign in or create an account to plan your drives and save your favorite routes.
Auth.passwordHint: One Google account. No extra password.
Auth.signInIntro: Continue with Google to save your profile and routes.

Dashboard.title: Plan a drive
Dashboard.intro: Tell us how you would like to spend your evening — we’ll find places and plan the route.
Dashboard.homeMapHint: Planned starting point, not your car’s live location.
Dashboard.homeMapMissing: Select your address from the suggestions in your profile to place it on the map.
Dashboard.homeMapUnavailable: The map is currently unavailable. You can still plan your drive.
Dashboard.manualBatteryHint: Battery is entered manually. Range is an estimate; vehicle image is illustrative.
Dashboard.assistantCue: Type what you want from the drive — this is a conversation with an AI route agent, not a blank form. When the plan is ready, open the 3D map.
Dashboard.copilotSubtitle: Find places that fit your car and your plans.
Dashboard.tripSettingsHint: Defaults for this chat — change anytime before you send.
Dashboard.addressSearchUnavailable: Address search needs a Mapbox token — type the full address.
Dashboard.promptPlaceholder: e.g. from office home for the kids, then a calm loop with dinner
Dashboard.emptyProposed: No open proposals — chat above to craft one.
Dashboard.errorGeneric: Check the form and try again.
Dashboard.errorUnauthorized: Sign in again to plan a route.
Dashboard.errorNoProfile: Add home and work addresses in your profile first.

Dashboard.errorParse: The planner returned an unexpected answer. Try again.
Dashboard.errorSave: Could not save the route. Try again.
